definition{
  name: natAt,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat, remaining : Nat, accumulated : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match remaining
    | Nat.zero => accumulated
    | Nat.succ rest => (match (Foundation.Bytes::byteAt value offset)
      | Option.none => accumulated
      | Option.some byte => (natAt value (offset + 1) rest ((prim multiply accumulated 256 : Nat) + (prim to_nat byte : Nat))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: remaining
}

definition{
  name: flag,
  parameters: [condition : Bool],
  result: Nat,
  body: (if condition then 1 else 0),
  axioms: []
}

definition{
  name: sameAddress,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, left : Nat, right : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (((natAt value left 8 0) =? (natAt value right 8 0)) && (((natAt value (left + 8) 8 0) =? (natAt value (right + 8) 8 0)) && (((natAt value (left + 16) 8 0) =? (natAt value (right + 16) 8 0)) && ((natAt value (left + 24) 8 0) =? (natAt value (right + 24) 8 0))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: admitAnswer,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if ((Comms.Admission::verdict (flag (sameAddress value 1 33)) (natAt value 65 1 0) (natAt value 66 1 0) (natAt value 67 1 0) (natAt value 68 1 0)) =? 1) then (prim utf8_encode "held" : Bytes) else (if ((Comms.Admission::verdict (flag (sameAddress value 1 33)) (natAt value 65 1 0) (natAt value 66 1 0) (natAt value 67 1 0) (natAt value 68 1 0)) =? 2) then (prim utf8_encode "admitted" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode "refused" : Bytes))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: permitAnswer,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (Comms.Rules::permitted (natAt value 1 1 0) (natAt value 2 1 0) (natAt value 3 8 0) (natAt value 11 1 0) (natAt value 12 8 0) (natAt value 20 8 0) (natAt value 28 1 0) (natAt value 29 8 0)) then (prim utf8_encode "permitted" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode "refused" : Bytes)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: leftPrecedes,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (Comms.Order::precedesWide (natAt value 1 8 0) (natAt value 9 8 0) (natAt value 17 8 0) (natAt value 25 8 0) (natAt value 33 8 0) (natAt value 41 8 0) (natAt value 49 8 0) (natAt value 57 8 0) (natAt value 65 8 0) (natAt value 73 8 0)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: rightPrecedes,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (Comms.Order::precedesWide (natAt value 41 8 0) (natAt value 49 8 0) (natAt value 57 8 0) (natAt value 65 8 0) (natAt value 73 8 0) (natAt value 1 8 0) (natAt value 9 8 0) (natAt value 17 8 0) (natAt value 25 8 0) (natAt value 33 8 0)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: orderAnswer,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (leftPrecedes value) then (prim utf8_encode "right" : Bytes) else (if (rightPrecedes value) then (prim utf8_encode "left" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode "same" : Bytes))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

  body: (if (Comms.Epoch::holdsKey (natAt value 1 8 0) (natAt value 9 8 0) (natAt value 17 8 0) (natAt value 25 1 0)) then (prim utf8_encode "holds" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode "withheld" : Bytes)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

  body: (if (state =? 0) then (prim utf8_encode "idle" : Bytes) else (if (state =? 1) then (prim utf8_encode "calling" : Bytes) else (if (state =? 2) then (prim utf8_encode "ringing" : Bytes) else (if (state =? 3) then (prim utf8_encode "connected" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode "ended" : Bytes))))),
  axioms: []
}

  body: (if (status =? 0) then (prim utf8_encode "absent" : Bytes) else (if (status =? 1) then (prim utf8_encode "invited" : Bytes) else (if (status =? 2) then (prim utf8_encode "joined" : Bytes) else (if (status =? 3) then (prim utf8_encode "departed" : Bytes) else (if (status =? 4) then (prim utf8_encode "banned" : Bytes) else (prim utf8_encode "invalid request" : Bytes)))))),

definition{
  name: wordsFrom,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat, remaining : Nat],
  result: Comms.Event::Words,
  body: (match remaining
    | Nat.zero => (record Comms.Event::Words {items := (nil Nat)})
    | Nat.succ rest => (record Comms.Event::Words {items := (cons (natAt value offset 8 0) (project (wordsFrom value (offset + 8) rest) items))})),

  recursive_argument: remaining
}

  name: eventWords,

definition{
  name: composeAnswer,
